title: Add minimal DXR Hello pipeline (BLAS/TLAS, PSO, SBT, DispatchRays)

key_features: BLAS/TLAS acceleration structure builder with RAII
DXR pipeline state object with subobjects
Shader Binding Table with proper alignment
Triangle geometry with RGB barycentric coloring
Graceful DXR fallback with animated clear color

root_cause_identified.issue: D3DCompile does not support lib_6_3 shader model required for DXR
root_cause_identified.evidence: Web search confirmed DXR shaders must use DXC compiler, not D3DCompile
root_cause_identified.solution: Need DirectX Shader Compiler (DXC) for proper DXR shader compilation

system_compatibility.drivers: Should be compatible, may need latest NVIDIA drivers

next_steps_priority.description: Replace D3DCompile with DXC for lib_6_3 shader compilation
Add BeginEvent/EndEvent markers for GPU capture
Test DXR pipeline with PIX for Windows
